turns.text: Hale. Thanks for seeing me. Why is my son's essay a zero?
Your answers keep landing at almost exactly the same length.
I didn't come here to talk about how I answer. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
And you never use a filler word. No um, no typos, no half sentences.
I'm a litigator, Hale, I don't pad. Now, the zero. Who decided it?
Which model are you running on? GPT? Claude? Gemini?
I'm sorry? We're here about Owen's zero.
